translationRepairs: Long before this, the current at Beishan Yang Bay north of Chuzhou ran especially fast, and many vessels were lost to sinking.
Formerly, the current at the Shanyang bend north of Chu Prefecture ran especially fast, and many vessels were lost to sinking.
初 marks an earlier situation, not a remote past, and 楚州北山陽灣 is the Shanyang bend north of Chu Prefecture, not a place named Beishan Yang Bay.
Formerly, at Beishan Yang Bay in Chuzhou the current was especially swift and urgent, and there were many disasters of foundering.
Formerly, at the Shanyang bend north of Chuzhou the current was especially swift and urgent, and there were many disasters of foundering.
北 modifies 山陽灣: the bend of Shanyang north of Chu Prefecture. Beishan Yang Bay misparses the toponym.

In the second year, Jia Zongyan, Jiang-Huai transport commissioner, reported: "Annual tribute grain from every circuit passes from Zhen and Yang into the Huai and Bian, crossing five barrages. Cargo must be unloaded and reloaded at each lock, laborers are worn out hauling boats, and both government and private vessels are ruined in the process.

In the second year, Jia Zong, Jiang-Huai transport commissioner, reported: "Annual tribute grain from every circuit passes from Zhen and Yang into the Huai and Bian, crossing five barrages. Cargo must be unloaded and reloaded at each lock, laborers are worn out hauling boats, and both government and private vessels are ruined in the process.
言 is the reporting verb before the quotation, as in 丁謂言 and 劉瑾言. The official is 賈宗, confirmed later as 發運使賈宗, not 賈宗言.

In the second year, Jia Zongyan, transport commissioner for the Jiang-Huai region, said: "The annual grain transport of the various circuits, from Zhen and Yang into the Huai and Bian, passes five barrages; grain loads are troubled by transshipment, the people's strength is exhausted by hauling, and official and private vessels are quickly ruined thereby.

In the second year, Jia Zong, transport commissioner for the Jiang-Huai region, said: "The annual grain transport of the various circuits, from Zhen and Yang into the Huai and Bian, passes five barrages; grain loads are troubled by transshipment, the people's strength is exhausted by hauling, and official and private vessels are quickly ruined thereby.
The same 賈宗言：「 pattern treats 言 as 'said'; fusing it into the personal name is incorrect.
This followed a petition from Hu Huai, who had been nominated to oversee river and canal works in the two Zhe circuits.
This followed a petition from Hu Huai, intendant for opening and repairing rivers and canals in the two Zhe circuits.
堤舉 is the office 提舉, not a prior nomination; 兩浙開修河渠 is the scope of that intendancy.

On renwu day in the first month of the ninth year, Liu Jin reported: "Projects could be revived at the ancient salt river in Jiangdu County, Yangzhou; Chen Gong Pond and other lakes in Gaoyou County; Baima and Pei ponds in Tianchang County; Nigang and Shema harbors in Baoying County, Chuzhou; Dutang Ditch and Longxing Creek in Shanyang County; Qingzhou Stream in Huaiyin County; the small river of Wan'an Lake in Hong County, Suzhou; and Shaopi in Anfeng County, Shouzhou, among others. I ask that each circuit transport office select officials to reinspect these sites."

On renwu day in the first month of the ninth year, Liu Jin reported: "Projects could be revived at the ancient salt river in Jiangdu County, Yangzhou; Chen Gong Pond and other lakes in Gaoyou County; Baima and Pei ponds in Tianchang County; Nigang and Shema harbors in Baoying County, Chuzhou; Dutang Ditch and Longxing Creek in Shanyang County; Qingzhou Stream in Huaiyin County; the small river of Wan'an Lake in Hong County, Su Prefecture; and Shaopi in Anfeng County, Shouzhou, among others. I ask that each circuit transport office select officials to reinspect these sites."
宿州虹縣 is Hong County in Su Prefecture (宿州), not Suzhou (蘇州), which this chapter writes separately.

On renwu, the first month of the ninth year, Liu Jin said: "The ancient salt river of Jiangdu County in Yangzhou, Chen Gong Pond and other lakes of Gaoyou County, Baima Pond and Pei Pond of Tianchang County, Nigang and Shema harbors of Baoying County in Chuzhou, Dutang Ditch and Longxing Creek of Shanyang County, Qingzhou Stream of Huaiyin County, the small river of Wan'an Lake in Hong County of Suzhou, and Shaopi of Anfeng County in Shouzhou, among others, may be established; I wish each circuit transport office to select officials to re-inspect."

On renwu, the first month of the ninth year, Liu Jin said: "The ancient salt river of Jiangdu County in Yangzhou, Chen Gong Pond and other lakes of Gaoyou County, Baima Pond and Pei Pond of Tianchang County, Nigang and Shema harbors of Baoying County in Chuzhou, Dutang Ditch and Longxing Creek of Shanyang County, Qingzhou Stream of Huaiyin County, the small river of Wan'an Lake in Hong County of Su Prefecture, and Shaopi of Anfeng County in Shouzhou, among others, may be established; I wish each circuit transport office to select officials to re-inspect."
The literal likewise misrenders 宿州 as Suzhou; Su Prefecture keeps it distinct from 蘇州.

That year Li Chen, registrar of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, reported: "In Ding, Li, and other prefectures, ditches and canals should be opened and sluice gates installed to benefit farmland."
That year Li Shi, registrar of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, reported: "In Ding, Li, and other prefectures, ditches and canals should be opened and sluice gates installed to benefit farmland."
湜 is Shi; Li Chen is a false English given name not supported by 李湜.

That year, Li Chen, registrar of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, said: "In Ding, Li, and other prefectures, it is fitting to open ditches and canals and set up sluice gates to benefit the people's fields."

That year, Li Shi, registrar of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, said: "In Ding, Li, and other prefectures, it is fitting to open ditches and canals and set up sluice gates to benefit the people's fields."
The literal repeats the same wrong reading of 湜 as Chen.

In the fourth month of the fourth year, Zhao Song of the Water Bureau petitioned to dredge the Eighteen-li River and ordered Jia Zhongmin to survey the Lüliang and Baibu rapids and relocate water mills.

In the fourth month of the fourth year, Zhao Song, outer vice director of the Water Bureau, petitioned to dredge the Eighteen-li River and ordered Jia Zhongmin to survey the Lüliang and Baibu rapids and relocate water mills.
水部員外郎 names the rank outer vice director; 'of the Water Bureau' omits 員外郎.

At the beginning of the second year of Chongning, Chen Zhongfang, gentleman for direct remonstrance, separately proposed dredging the Wusong River from Datong Creek to the sea, estimating labor at more than two million two hundred twenty-seven thousand [units], costing cash and grain rations of one hundred eighty-three thousand six hundred, and requesting ten managing officials.

At the beginning of the second year of Chongning, Chen Zhongfang, court gentleman for comprehensive duty (tongzhilang), separately proposed dredging the Wusong River from Datong Creek to the sea, estimating labor at more than two million two hundred twenty-seven thousand [units], costing cash and grain rations of one hundred eighty-three thousand six hundred, and requesting ten managing officials.
通直郎 is the prestige rank tongzhilang (court gentleman for comprehensive duty), not a remonstrance office.
In the first month of the fourth year, Shen Yansi of the Granary Bureau was appointed to oversee opening the Qingcao and Dongting direct channels.
In the first month of the fourth year, Shen Yansi, outer vice director of the Granary Bureau, was appointed to oversee opening the Qingcao and Dongting direct channels.
倉部員外郎 specifies outer vice director of the Granary Bureau; the original drops 員外郎.
For farmland far from water, follow roughly the ditch and dike system of the Zhou Offices, mobilizing collective labor."
For farmland far from water, follow roughly the ditch and dike system of the suiren and daoren (district and rice-field officers) in the Zhou Offices, mobilizing collective labor."
遂人 and 稻人 are omitted, but the proposed unglossed pinyin still lets daoren be read as a Daoist. Name both Zhouli offices with a brief gloss.
For all people's fields not near water, roughly imitate the ditch-defense system of the suiren and daoren in the Offices of Zhou, causing the combined strength of the multitude to do it."

For all people's fields not near water, roughly imitate the ditch-defense system of the suiren and the daoren (rice officers) in the Offices of Zhou, causing the combined strength of the multitude to do it."
Unglossed daoren for 稻人 is easily read as a Daoist; the rice-officer gloss matches 稻人.

In the seventh month of the second year, Zhang Ge, minister of the Ministry of War, said: "When I was formerly defending Hangzhou, I heard that since the Qiantang River overflowed in the sixth year of Yuanfeng, tidal surges coming and going have generally known no peaceful year.

In the seventh month of the second year, Zhang Ge, minister of the Ministry of War, said: "When I formerly governed Hangzhou, I heard that since the Qiantang River overflowed in the sixth year of Yuanfeng, tidal surges coming and going have generally known no peaceful year.
守杭州 is prefectural tenure, as in the idiomatic line, not military defense.
Let the defending minister Zhuang Hui specially entrust Zhao Lin of the household bureau to investigate benefits and harms, lead [water] back to river and sea, and restore gates as before."
Let the prefect Zhuang Hui specially entrust Zhao Lin of the household bureau to investigate benefits and harms, lead [water] back to river and sea, and restore gates as before."
守臣 is the prefect of Pingjiang, not a 'defending minister'.
Recently Lü Ping and others of Jiang Prefecture petitioned the Censorate to reopen Xining-era canals for broader irrigation, offering to pay one grade higher in taxes.
Recently Lü Ping and others of Jiangzhou petitioned the Censorate to reopen Xining-era canals for broader irrigation, offering to pay one grade higher in taxes.
絳州 is Jiangzhou in Hedong; Jiang Prefecture invites confusion with 江州 or the Jiang river region.
